title: security(rbac-v2): enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging enhancements for data residency
author: Priya Patel
description: Motivation: Close gaps between RBAC v2 policy evaluation and KMS region residency constraints and improve auditability for compliance reviews. This change enforces KMS region pinning during policy checks (preventing cross-region KMS selections that violate policy), expands audit log entries with residency context, and provides a migration/backfill path for existing keys. Scope: RBAC v2 policy engine, KMS-integrations, audit-log schema, console validation and API behaviors. Implementation highlights: 1) Policy engine: added region_pin constraint evaluation and policy deny path when pinning is violated; 2) KMS adapter: surface region metadata and canonicalize key resource ids for consistent residency checks; 3) Audit logs: new fields added (kms_region, residency_policy_id, policy_decision_reason) and wirecompat shim to include these for both hosted and private deployments; 4) Console/API: user-facing validation on key selection with clear error messages and suggested remediation steps; 5) Migration: backfill job to populate residency metadata for existing KMS bindings and a safe rollout guard behind a runtime feature flag. Checklist: - [x] Add policy evaluation logic and unit tests - [x] Extend KMS adapter and integration tests - [x] Add audit log fields + tests - [x] Console validation + e2e tests - [x] Backfill job and migration plan - [x] Rollout behind feature flag with gradual enforcement - [x] Security review completed Backwards compatibility: The audit log additions are additive and include a compatibility shim. Policy enforcement is gated behind a rollout flag; when disabled, the system records policy decisions but does not deny requests. Rollout plan: start with 10% of traffic in us-east-1 for hosted, enable for Dedicated customers in opt-in mode, monitor audit signals and error rates for 2 weeks, then ramp to 100% if no regressions. Migration notes: a background backfill populates kms_region for existing key bindings; any missing region metadata will be treated as "unknown" and surfaced to the console to prompt remediation. See release notes for admin steps.

feat(audit): include kms_region and residency_policy_id in audit events
feat(console): validation UI for KMS region pinning and actionable errors
test: add unit/integration/e2e coverage for region pinning and audit fields
ci: add migration/backfill job and safety checks
docs: update security/compliance docs and migration guide
review_thread: Review summary: initial review requested by Rohit Singh focused on policy semantics and performance; Lina flagged an edge case where keys without region metadata could be incorrectly denied - addressed by introducing an explicit 'unknown' region treatment and backfill. Ava requested more detailed audit fields and retention guidance; added kms_region, residency_policy_id and policy_decision_reason and added tests. Marcus ran load tests and raised concerns about evaluator hot paths; optimized evaluator with cached region lookups. Final approvals: Rohit (approved), Lina (approved after changes), Ava (approved). Author replies included clarifications on migration safety and rollback via feature flag.
ci_checks: ci/build: pass; ci/unit-tests: pass; ci/integration-tests: pass; ci/e2e: pass (flaky on first run, re-run passed); ci/lint: pass; security-scan: pass; perf/regression-check: no significant regressions
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning in RBAC v2 policy evaluation (behind feature flag); Add kms_region, residency_policy_id and policy_decision_reason to audit logs for improved compliance tracing; Backfill job to populate KMS residency metadata; Console validation and remediation hints for admins; Rollout plan: gradual enforcement starting at 10% traffic.
testing: Unit tests added for policy evaluator and KMS adapter (coverage ~92% in changed modules). Integration tests run against AWS and GCP adapters. End-to-end tests exercise console flows and API rejections. Load tests showed <2% latency impact in policy evaluation path after adding cache. Migration backfill validated on subset of staging tenants before production roll-out.
rollout_plan: Feature flag 'rbac_v2_kms_region_enforce' toggles enforcement. Phase 1: audit-only (record decisions) for all traffic for 48h. Phase 2: enable enforcement for 10% of hosted traffic + opt-in Dedicated customers for 2 weeks. Phase 3: 50% -> 100% after monitoring. Backout: disable feature flag and run backfill to reconcile state. Ops runbook updated.
notes_for_ops: Prior to enabling enforcement, run scripts/migrations/backfill_kms_residency.py to populate kms_region. Watch residency_policy_alerts and residency_policy_dashboard. Key owners with 'unknown' region will be listed in console; remediation steps in docs/security/kms-region-pinning.md.
security_review: Completed by Security team (SEC-4302). Minor findings addressed: explicit 'unknown' region handling, audit retention guidance added, and rate limits to prevent backfill surge. Security acceptance recorded in linked linear SEC-4302.
auditing_compatibility: Audit schema change is additive. For consumers expecting the old schema, a compatibility shim emits legacy events until adapter version 2.0 is rolled out. Consumers that depend on kms_region should verify schema version in event metadata.
